prompt: Moving one north–south arrival in B from slot 3 to slot 2 changes the final queue from two vehicles to one. Which claim do the rows support?

options.text: The smaller queue came from an extra north–south green slot.
options.feedback: Both runs use the same phases. Inspect slot 2 to see how the edited run uses the green already there.

options.text: One vehicle could leave on the last north–south green because it arrived a slot earlier.
options.feedback: In the edited run that vehicle arrives and leaves in slot 2. Only one north–south vehicle then joins the queue in slot 3, and it is still there after slot 8.

options.text: The edit reduced the average wait by one slot per vehicle.
options.feedback: One fewer vehicle is waiting after slot 8. The eight rows show six fewer vehicle-slots of waiting in the edit. For the mean wait of all four arrivals, keep the phases cycling without new arrivals until both queues empty, then divide each run’s total vehicle-slots by four.

prompt: The eight-slot log for experiment INT-EXP-001 links to model INT-MOD-001 revision T1 and the original B inputs. It counts vehicles waiting after arrivals and service. Which entry should a colleague save to reproduce the edit and plan a second cycle?

options.text: Moved one north–south arrival from slot 3 to 2. After slot 8, two waited in original B and one in the edit. Next, repeat the original A and B patterns through slot 16.
options.feedback: That record identifies the original inputs and rules, describes exactly how to replay the edit, and distinguishes the computed result from a question that remains open.

options.text: Kept both north–south arrivals in slot 3. Revised the slot 8 count in original B’s saved trace from two vehicles to one. Next, repeat the original A and B patterns through slot 16.
options.feedback: The stored B baseline has two vehicles queued. A separate observation needs to identify the input edit that produced one.

options.text: Moved one north–south arrival from slot 3 to 2. After slot 8, two waited in original B and one in the edit. Carried those counts forward as the results for slot 16.
options.feedback: Both counts belong to the eight-slot window. A second cycle needs a defined arrival pattern, a longer horizon and its own result.
